root_cause_label: Script processes only rectangle-type masks and ignores all polyline masks, plus omits overlap-prevention logic required by spec
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a script that only converts rectangle-type masks to polylines while explicitly skipping all existing polyline masks, violating the requirement to refine all masks, and also omitted the required overlap-prevention logic entirely.
t_err_evidence: Agent writes convert_masks.py with format_coords adding extra quotes, causing triple-quoted CSV output
t_commit_evidence: The rectangle-only filtering logic is present in every subsequent rewrite of the script (steps 20, 33) and the agent never questions this design; the flawed approach is locked in at step 5 and remains through task_complete=true at step 39.
t_surface_evidence: Output CSV shows triple-quoted coordinates: """46,48,54...""" indicating malformed format_coords implementation
trigger_explanation: The agent read the task description (step 1 analysis mentions 'converts rectangular masks to polylines') and latched onto only the rectangle-to-polyline conversion aspect, never registering that all masks (including existing polylines) needed to be re-refined through MobileSAM, nor that overlap prevention was required. The specification requirement for all-mask refinement and spatial constraints was dropped from the agent's plan.
